description: This file contains code generation logic for creating C++ view function classes and associated functions for autograd in PyTorch. It defines templates, helper functions, and a main function to generate header and source files for view functions based on native function definitions.

classes.name: struct
classes.description: Template for generating view function classes with methods for getting/setting state, invoking the function, and cloning.

methods.name: view_func_name
methods.description: Generates a function name for a view function, optionally in CamelCase and with namespace.

methods.name: is_symint_or_tensor
methods.description: Checks if an argument is tensor-like or symint-like.

methods.name: remove_const_ref
methods.description: Removes const reference qualifier from a binding.

methods.name: returns_multi_tensor
methods.description: Determines if a native function returns a list-like tensor, indicating multiple tensors.

methods.name: generate_state_getter_setter
methods.description: Generates code for getting and setting state variables (symints, tensors) for view functions.

methods.name: process_function
methods.description: Processes a native function to generate its declaration and definition code snippets based on templates.

methods.name: gen_view_funcs
methods.description: Main function to generate header and source files for view functions based on provided native functions and templates.
